subtitle: A small, west-facing marine-reserve beach at Manly where snorkelling replaced what a 1920s amusement-park scheme nearly built instead.
spike_statement: A 1920s scheme to turn Manly's Shelly Beach foreshore into an amusement park was defeated by locals; the site became a no-take marine reserve in 2002.

levers.photo_tone: West-facing late-afternoon light over a small marine-reserve cove, snorkellers silhouetted at the reef edge, sand pale against deep protected blue water.
